item.text: The customer code and contract already enforce explicit consent for both `consent.check` and `offer`, and the tests cover implied/none consent. The gate failure is a rollout-safety issue: with a one-at-a-time customer rollout, an old customer instance can continue emitting implied-consent offers after the new rule is live. I’m tightening the release constraint to make the customer/notifier switch atomic and will add regression coverage/documentation for the mixed-version and rollback boundary.
